item.text: {"results":[{"pair_id":"J01535","case1_error":"Counts all 15 videos on the final list despite Billy choosing the fifth, overcounting by 10.","case2_error":"Divides the international surcharge by all four letters instead of the two international letters.","reason":"The first ignores the stopping position on the final list; the second uses the wrong population to calculate a per-letter surcharge.","judgment":"different"},{"pair_id":"J01536","case1_error":"Charges for one sandwich instead of two, and evaluates the displayed sum as $30.25 instead of $32.25.","case2_error":"Subtracts missed days from seven calendar days instead of five school days.","reason":"The first omits a purchased unit and miscalculates its sum; the second uses an incorrect baseline for attendance.","judgment":"different"},{"pair_id":"J01537","case1_error":"Omits the 20% primer discount, charging full price.","case2_error":"Treats the $2 price for five cans as the price per can.","reason":"Ignoring a discount differs from interpreting a bundle price as a unit price.","judgment":"different"},{"pair_id":"J01538","case1_error":"Incorrectly equates current practice with half itself and asserts x = 2 without valid substitution into the formula.","case2_error":"Divides the full weekly requirement by five elapsed days, ignoring consumption already completed and the two remaining days.","reason":"The first introduces false equalities and an unsupported conclusion; the second constructs the wrong rate calculation for the remaining requirement.","judgment":"different"},{"pair_id":"J01539","case1_error":"Adds the two parent lambs again even though they are already included in the initial six.","case2_error":"Omits Ariana's half-hour when subtracting completed legs from total race time to obtain Sarah's time.","reason":"Explicitly duplicating members of an existing count differs from omitting a component in a remainder calculation.","judgment":"different"}]}
